name: @w6w-apps/booqable
description: Manage Booqable rental orders, customers, products and stock.

w6w.longDescription:
Booqable is rental and equipment management software. This app covers the rental lifecycle from a workflow — creating, updating and fetching orders, transitioning an order through Booqable's draft/reserved/started/stopped/archived status machine, and searching or archiving customers, products and orders.

Customers can be created, updated, fetched, listed, searched and archived, so a workflow can look up or create the renter behind a booking. Products (the rentable catalog items) can be created, updated, fetched, listed and searched, and archived when discontinued. Stock items — the individually tracked or bulk-counted physical units behind a product — and plannings — the reservations that tie an order's line items to a date range — can be listed and fetched to check what is actually booked or in stock.

A fit for routing an external booking request into a new Booqable order, moving an order through its rental lifecycle as a workflow progresses (reserve it, start it, stop it), or syncing customer and inventory data between Booqable and the rest of a rental business's stack.
